about.seoDescription: RNG Sport is a sports media agency providing photo and video coverage at sports events, with a focus on rhythmic gymnastics. Read how we work on competition day.
about.seoKeywords: about rng sport, sports media agency, rhythmic gymnastics film crew, competition photographer, tournament video
about.heroText: We know when, where and what to follow to get the right shot. We build our shooting plan around the structure of the event and the discipline.
about.title: About Us
about.p1: <1>RNG Sport</1> is a team providing photo and video production services for sports events.
about.p2: We shoot at competitions, tournaments and events in various disciplines, with a focus on rhythmic gymnastics. Depending on the event, we prepare photos, videos, reels and athlete-specific content.
about.how1: Every sport is filmed differently. That's why, before the event begins, we build our shooting plan around the discipline, the venue layout and the competition flow.
about.how2: Throughout the event, we follow the athletes' performances, capture photos and videos, and after the shoot we edit and deliver the content.

audiences.title: For Athletes
paragraphs: Athletes and parents can make a booking through RNG Sport before the event.
When the shots are ready, we notify you by email. After signing in, photos and videos are available in your personal gallery.

audiences.title: For Organisers
paragraphs: Together we decide on the crew, number of cameras and content plan according to the size and needs of the event.
Our goal is a smooth shooting process during the event and easy delivery of the content to the athletes afterwards.
